title: 2023 Near Mint Pokemon Hypno 097/165 Reverse 151 SV2a Japanese Poke Ball
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This 2023 Hypno Pokémon card is a must-have for any collector. With its reverse holo finish and Japanese language, it is sure to stand out in any collection. The card features the iconic Hypno character and is from the 151st set. It is made from high-quality card stock and is in near mint condition. 

This card is perfect for players of the Pokémon TCG and fans of the franchise. It is standard size and has a card number of 097/165. The card is not autographed, but its rarity and unique features make it a valuable addition to any collection. Don't miss out on the chance to own this incredible card.
